steps.question: Of your {{gross}} lei gross salary, how much goes to your pension each month?

steps.title: The fund nobody chose
steps.body: If you're under 35 and don't pick a Pillar II fund within 4 months, one is assigned to you. {{pillar2Line}} The {{pillar2}} lei a month that goes there is yours, and it can be inherited.

steps.title: Pay yourself first
steps.body: Every payday, move a fixed amount into savings, in your own bank. Rost never moves your money.
